folderShelf.configFile.description: Absolute path of the JSON file that stores the item list (e.g. `/Users/me/sync/config.json`). `~` expands to the home directory. Leave empty to use `~/.folder-shelf/config.json` (default), falling back to the extension's global storage if unavailable.
folderShelf.dragToTagAction.description: Decides what happens to an item's existing tags when you drag it onto another tag node in the tag view.
folderShelf.dragToTagAction.alwaysAsk.de: Show a confirmation dialog every time, letting you choose how to proceed.
folderShelf.dragToTagAction.removeCurren: The item no longer belongs to the original tag "A" and instead belongs to the new tag "B"; its other existing tags are unchanged.
The item belongs to both "A" and "B": all existing tags are kept and the new tag is added.
